SOLAR SYSTEM / THE SUN

Our star.
Everything begins with light.

A world of plasma, powered by fusion. Meet the star at the heart of our solar system.

ARTISTIC MODEL · TEXTURE & ROTATION NOT TO SCALE
DIAMETER~1.4 million km
CORE TEMPERATURE~15 million °C
AGE~4.6 billion years
01 / THE ENGINE

Fusion at the center

Hydrogen fuses into helium in the core, releasing energy that eventually escapes as sunlight.

02 / THE LAYERS

From core to corona

Energy travels through the radiative and convection zones. Above them lie the photosphere, chromosphere and corona.

03 / SPACE WEATHER

A restless star

Magnetic activity produces sunspots, flares and eruptions. Some eruptions can affect Earth’s space environment.

LOOK A LITTLE CLOSER

Small facts. Big discoveries.

01

No solid ground

The visible “surface” is a layer of hot plasma called the photosphere.

02

An unexpected temperature

The corona is much hotter than the visible surface.

03

Different speeds

The equator rotates in about 25 Earth days; the poles take about 36.
